events_retention_floor.name: events_retention_floor
events_retention_floor.using: delivered_at is not null and occurred_at < now() - interval '1 day'

native_apps_ios_whole.name: native_apps_ios_whole
native_apps_ios_whole.value: "tula"."native_apps"."platform" <> 'ios' or ("tula"."native_apps"."team_id" is not null and "tula"."native_apps"."team_id" ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{10}$' and cardinality("tula"."native_apps"."sha256_cert_fingerprints") = 0)

native_apps_android_whole.name: native_apps_android_whole
native_apps_android_whole.value: "tula"."native_apps"."platform" <> 'android' or ("tula"."native_apps"."team_id" is null and cardinality("tula"."native_apps"."sha256_cert_fingerprints") between 1 and 10)

native_apps_fingerprints_shape.name: native_apps_fingerprints_shape
native_apps_fingerprints_shape.value: array_position("tula"."native_apps"."sha256_cert_fingerprints", null) is null and array_to_string("tula"."native_apps"."sha256_cert_fingerprints", ',') ~ '^(([0-9A-F]{2}:){31}[0-9A-F]{2}(,([0-9A-F]{2}:){31}[0-9A-F]{2})*)?$' and char_length(array_to_string("tula"."native_apps"."sha256_cert_fingerprints", ',')) = greatest(96 * cardinality("tula"."native_apps"."sha256_cert_fingerprints") - 1, 0)

native_apps_app_link_paths_shape.name: native_apps_app_link_paths_shape
native_apps_app_link_paths_shape.value: cardinality("tula"."native_apps"."app_link_paths") <= 10 and array_position("tula"."native_apps"."app_link_paths", null) is null and array_to_string("tula"."native_apps"."app_link_paths", ',') ~ '^((/[A-Za-z0-9._~-]+)+(,(/[A-Za-z0-9._~-]+)+)*)?$' and array_to_string("tula"."native_apps"."app_link_paths", ',') !~ '/\.\.?(/|,|$)' and char_length(array_to_string("tula"."native_apps"."app_link_paths", ',')) - char_length(replace(array_to_string("tula"."native_apps"."app_link_paths", ','), ',', '')) = greatest(cardinality("tula"."native_apps"."app_link_paths") - 1, 0) and char_length(array_to_string("tula"."native_apps"."app_link_paths", ',')) <= 2560 and (cardinality("tula"."native_apps"."app_link_paths") = 0 or char_length(array_to_string("tula"."native_apps"."app_link_paths", ',')) >= 2)

organization_domains_state.name: organization_domains_state
organization_domains_state.value: ("tula"."organization_domains"."verified_at" is null) = ("tula"."organization_domains"."expires_at" is null) and ("tula"."organization_domains"."verified_at" is not null or "tula"."organization_domains"."code_hash" is not null) and ("tula"."organization_domains"."code_hash" is null) = ("tula"."organization_domains"."code_expires_at" is null)

organization_roles_permissions_shape.name: organization_roles_permissions_shape
organization_roles_permissions_shape.value: cardinality("tula"."organization_roles"."permissions") <= 32 and array_position("tula"."organization_roles"."permissions", null) is null and array_to_string("tula"."organization_roles"."permissions", ',') ~ '^((org:(sys:[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}|(?!sys:)[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}):[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31})(,org:(sys:[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}|(?!sys:)[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}):[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31})*)?$' and char_length(array_to_string("tula"."organization_roles"."permissions", ',')) - char_length(replace(array_to_string("tula"."organization_roles"."permissions", ','), ',', '')) = greatest(cardinality("tula"."organization_roles"."permissions") - 1, 0)

proposals_approval_whole.name: proposals_approval_whole
proposals_approval_whole.value: ("tula"."proposals"."status" = 'pending') = ("tula"."proposals"."approved_at" is null) and ("tula"."proposals"."status" = 'pending') = ("tula"."proposals"."approved_by_type" is null) and ("tula"."proposals"."approved_by_type" is null or "tula"."proposals"."approved_by_type" in ('admin', 'instance_admin')) and ("tula"."proposals"."approved_by_id" is null or ("tula"."proposals"."approved_by_type" is not null and char_length("tula"."proposals"."approved_by_id") between 1 and 128))

proposals_failure_whole.name: proposals_failure_whole
proposals_failure_whole.value: ("tula"."proposals"."status" = 'failed') = ("tula"."proposals"."failure_reason" is not null) and ("tula"."proposals"."failure_reason" is null or "tula"."proposals"."failure_reason" ~ '^[a-z_]{1,64}$')

users_email_whole.name: users_email_whole
users_email_whole.value: ("tula"."users"."email" IS NULL) = ("tula"."users"."email_normalized" IS NULL) AND ("tula"."users"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "tula"."users"."email_verified_at" IS NULL)

users_sms_factor_needs_number.name: users_sms_factor_needs_number
users_sms_factor_needs_number.value: "tula"."users"."sms_factor_enabled_at" IS NULL OR "tula"."users"."phone_number" IS NOT NULL

webhook_deliveries_retention_floor.name: webhook_deliveries_retention_floor
webhook_deliveries_retention_floor.using: state <> 'pending' and created_at < now() - interval '7 days'
